note: Checked live doc 01 and Wayback doc 02 (capture 2026-01-05). Doc 01 is the Atlantic Council live article, dated December 6, 2024. It says Romania annulled the first-round results after reports alleging a Russian campaign benefiting Georgescu on TikTok and Telegram. The text describes the claims as allegations, not established facts; it says the decision was “historic and unprecedented” but does not say this was the first European election cancelled over cyber interference. It also does not call the activity a TikTok bot campaign. Corrected to retain only supported detail and dated the event to the documented article/event date (December 6).

An alternative-source search surfaced Pew’s July 30, 2025 article on a similar 80% finding, but that is a separately dated later publication and does not verify this alleged September 2024 finding; no alternative was fetched.

Doc 01 is the live Wikipedia article. It states that on 3 December 190 legislators unanimously demanded lifting martial law, which Yoon lifted around 04:00 KST on 4 December; it says the National Assembly voted to impeach him on 14 December. The text does not state a 190–0 vote count, an elapsed duration of “within 6 hours,” or that impeachment occurred “within 11 days”; it distinguishes 190 present legislators’ unanimous demand from the later impeachment vote (204 in favor). Corrected the claim to the dated actions and vote detail explicitly stated in the article. The martial-law event date is documented as 3 December, not the ledger’s 1 December.

Doc 01 is the Guardian’s live article, published 27 December 2024. It attributes the 10%–20% chance of AI causing human extinction within three decades to Geoffrey Hinton, and states that he previously gave a 10% chance of a catastrophic outcome for humanity. The headline also specifies the next 30 years. These support the claim’s estimate, time horizon, attribution, and raised odds.

Checked the live AARP page (doc 01), including its study findings and methodology. It supports 40% of U.S. adults age 45-plus now reporting loneliness and 35% in both 2010 and 2018; it does not state the legacy claim’s comparison figures for 2020 or 2023, so those were dropped. The methodology dates the underlying survey to August 2025.

Checked the live Guardian article, published 30 December 2025 (doc 01). The article says the AI was used autonomously to hunt for targets, assess vulnerabilities, and access them for intelligence collection (doc 01), but the shorter corrected claim avoids adding unsupported specifics.
